utterances.text: The AFC Under-20 Women Asian Cup Thailand 2026
enters the business end with the quarterfinals to be played over the weekend.
All four ties promise to be scintillating affairs.
after an exciting group stage which saw thrills, spills and more.
Join theafc.com in our preview of the quarterfinals.
The quarterfinal action kicks off with Japan and Vietnam squaring off
at the Patam Thani Stadium with the former firm favourites.
Japan cruised into the quarterfinals with a perfect record of three wins in Group C.
Such was their dominance that Japan netted 13 times
and conceded only twice as they showed their determination to reclaim the title.
after falling in the final of the 2024 edition.
